# COMRAD

> > Premium graduated compression socks designed for everyday comfort, circulation support, and health benefits for men and women.

COMRAD specializes in high-quality compression socks with True Graduated Compression™ technology, offering targeted solutions for daily wear, athletic performance, pregnancy support, and medical-grade compression relief. The product line includes multiple compression levels (10-15 mmHg to 20-30 mmHg), fit options (knee-high, ankle, wide calf), and curated bundle packs for different lifestyle needs.

## Key Topics

- True Graduated Compression™
- mmHg compression levels
- Knee-high compression socks
- Medical-grade (20-30 mmHg)
- Everyday wear
- Circulation support
- Pregnancy support
- Athletic performance
- Wide calf options
- Targeted arch compression
- Travel socks
- Sock bundles
- Healthcare professionals
- All-day comfort
- Post-workout recovery
